transient: the tracker's issue store is busy or the read is interrupted (sqlite OperationalError, ConnectionError, InterruptedError): retried in code up to 3 times
permanent: the issue number names no issue
number is not an integer, or is not positive (rejected at the boundary)
an unknown or missing argument (rejected at the boundary)

transient: the search index or a file cannot be read for a moment (OperationalError, ConnectionError, InterruptedError): retried in code up to 3 times
permanent: empty or whitespace-only query
query longer than 200 characters
path_glob that is not a valid glob
max_results outside 1 to 20
source or response_format not one of its enum values

transient: a file read interrupted or the disk busy (InterruptedError, BlockingIOError): retried in code up to 3 times
permanent: the path is not on the repository's file list (case-sensitive; near misses named)
the path is under config/, never readable
the path leaves the repository (leading / or ..) or is a glob
the file is not text
start_line past the end of the file, or below 1

transient: the tracker times out before the write is dispatched, or the check before the write cannot connect for a moment
permanent: the issue number names no issue
the body is empty, over 4,000 characters, or lacks a valid label: and file: line (rejected at the boundary)
a hook denies the write (for example a body that looks like a credential)
ambiguous: the tracker times out after the write was dispatched (TrackerTimeout): it may have committed; read back by key, then retry with the same key or escalate
the read-back after a timeout fails too (ReadbackUnavailable): escalate

transient: the tracker times out before the write is dispatched, or the check before the write cannot connect for a moment
permanent: the issue number names no issue
branch is not repomind/issue-<number>
title empty, over 120 characters or over several lines
body empty or over 4,000 characters
a hook denies the write
ambiguous: the tracker times out after the write was dispatched (TrackerTimeout): it may have committed; read back by branch, then retry with the same key or escalate
the read-back after a timeout fails too (ReadbackUnavailable): escalate
